subject: Headcount prioritization: scoring rubric and QBR decision request
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount prioritization: scoring rubric and QBR decision request

Hi all,

As part of QBR prep and the OKR check-in next week I pulled a simple scoring rubric to help prioritize active reqs and backfills across Product, Serving, and SRE. Goal is to produce a short list (<=3 reqs) for executive approval by Friday so we can lock hiring commitments for May.

Proposal (attached): headcount_rubric_v2.xlsx — columns: OKR impact (0-5), time-to-fill (weeks), criticality (service-SLA/customer-impact), revenue-risk, ramp-time. I ran the first pass and the top five by composite score are:
- Serving Engineer (backfill) — score 18
- Senior SRE (new headcount) — score 17
- Backend IC (new) — score 14
- Data Infra (backfill) — score 13
- Product Ops (new) — score 12

Asks:
1) Please review the rubric and scores (sheet: summaries).
2) Call out any adjustments to weighting (I used OKR impact x2).
3) Vote for the two reqs you want to prioritize for immediate approval and budget slot.

Quick context: Serving backfill is tied to the Q2 latency SLA for a named customer (Acme Analytics). SRE req is to support the Dedicated cluster expansion (Q3 commit). If we can't commit now, we risk delayed rollouts and potential SLA breaches.

Attachments: headcount_rubric_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Target: decision by EOD Fri (2026-04-24) so recruiting can open reqs in Greenhouse and we can engage sourcing.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Manager, Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount prioritization: scoring rubric and QBR decision request

Dylan — thanks for pulling this together. Quick read-through: rubric looks reasonable. Two quick asks before I vote:

- Can you add a short justification note per req about customer exposure (e.g., "Serving backfill: supports Acme Analytics SLOs; 3 incidents in last 30 days")?
- Please include current open pipeline for each role (how many active candidates / time-to-offer historically).

My initial inclination is to prioritize the Serving backfill and Senior SRE. If we can see the justification and pipeline data I can confirm.

Also tagging Markus for any budget constraints we should be aware of before we lock.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount prioritization: scoring rubric and QBR decision request

Quick note — supporting the Serving backfill as top priority. Two reasons:
1) Customer-facing latency regressions have correlated with our reduced servicing capacity; Acme saw a 12% tail-latency increase in March. See attachment (sla-incident-log.csv).
2) Without that backfill, our rollout for Dedicated cluster improvements (Q2 -> Q3) will backlog several launches.

If Markus wants to preserve headcount for strategic infra (SRE), we can split the approvals: approve Serving backfill now, SRE can be conditional on a budget reallocation in May.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Support & Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sla-incident-log.csv (excerpt)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount prioritization: scoring rubric and QBR decision request

Thanks, team — solid framing and useful data. Decision summary and next steps: 

Decision (effective immediately):
- APPROVE: Serving Engineer (backfill) — recruiting to open req in Greenhouse (see link).
- APPROVE: Senior SRE (headcount) — confirm hiring range and go to market; budget moved from FY26 reserved discretionary pool.
- HOLD/FREEZE: Backend IC (new) and Product Ops (new) — keep in the pipeline but no active hiring until Q3 re-review.

Conditions / operational asks:
- Dylan: please add the per-req justification notes Lauren requested and update the rubric sheet with current pipeline metrics by EOD tomorrow.
- Grace: coordinate a short technical bar rubric for the Serving role so recruiters have a clear scorecard.
- Recruiting: open both approved reqs in Greenhouse (link) and tag for priority sourcing.
- Procurement (cc'd): please start any vendor engagement for sourcing / contract templates; we'll need expedited vendor onboarding if we use agencies.

I'll file this as the QBR headcount decision and share in the leadership pack. If anyone strongly disagrees, reply all within 24 hours; otherwise we'll move forward.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of People Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference

Greenhouse links: https://greenhouse.io/jobs/RED-1234 (Serving), https://greenhouse.io/jobs/RED-1235 (Senior SRE)
